title: Zoe theme
description: A sunny food-science theme: a white page with deep navy ink, one sunflower-yellow brand colour for buttons and bands, warm cream cards, pale mint quote cards, and two rich bands, deep teal and plum. Figtree throughout with a light bookish serif (Newsreader) and a tall condensed caps face (Antonio) for accents; soft 16–24px radii, flat surfaces. A deep-navy dark sibling.
notes: secondary is the plum footer band and highlight the deep-teal stories band, both with white text in both modes
ring doubles as the violet link colour (links turn it on hover)
sets two theme-only faces for zoe blocks: --zoe-serif (Newsreader) and --zoe-condensed (Antonio)
